description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Revise the Fuel Price to be effect from 12.00 midnight on June 30, 2023
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Kanchana Wijesekera, Minister of Power and Energy) AND detailed government responsibilities/portfolios (exercising powers under the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act to revise fuel prices). The content includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (specific regulatory action and responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
